deployment.selection_rule: Operational values may be injected directly through the process environment or through the explicit operational configuration selector. The framework must not search a repository-relative fallback path.

owns: decompose broad TODOs into implementation leaves when needed
must_not: use the configured review or merge principal for implementation, commit, push, or pull request creation

owns: request changes when CI, evidence, policy, or implementation is insufficient
approve pull requests when the review is satisfied and the repository policy allows approval
must_not: perform implementation work through the configured review principal

owns: merge pull requests after required checks and review policy are satisfied
must_not: merge without required review and checks

requirements: Implementation, review, merge, repository, branch, credential-profile, binary, path, timeout, retry, and controller operating values are supplied by deployment configuration or explicit process configuration, never from source-code defaults.
The deployment configuration must bind a repository, a GitHub principal for each role, and implementation branch prefixes.
The implementation credential profile must be repository-private and must not silently fall back to a host-default account.
Runtime preflight must verify gh api user against the deployment role principal before implementation, review, or merge operations.

Private local state, VM disks, VM images, credentials, screenshots, and machine-local scratch files must live under .brownie/private/ so shared Brownie evidence under .brownie/release-evidence/ remains trackable.
forbidden_success_claims: Do not treat an implementation result as independently reviewed when the configured implementation and review principals are the same.
Do not relax branch protection to compensate for actor collapse except as an explicit temporary owner emergency action.
Do not treat static review JSON as GitHub review provenance for a concrete implementation pull request.
